def: properly, perhaps to tie, i.e. (figuratively and reflexively) to owe, or (by implication) to forfeit

words.word: then shall ye make me endanger

occurrences.text: And the prince of the eunuchs said unto Daniel, I fear my lord the king, who hath appointed your meat and your drink: for why should he see your faces worse liking than the children which are of your sort? then shall ye make me endanger my head to the king.
